reconstructed_captions.24: The scene fades in to a close-up of a man's hands arranging tinder in a rock fire pit.
reconstructed_captions.25: He carefully places small twigs and kindling on top of the tinder bundle.
reconstructed_captions.26: The man's hands bring a ferro rod and a metal striker into the frame.
reconstructed_captions.27: He positions the tip of the ferro rod close to the tinder.
reconstructed_captions.28: He scrapes the striker down the length of the ferro rod, creating a shower of sparks.
reconstructed_captions.29: He strikes the rod again, aiming the sparks directly into the tinder.
reconstructed_captions.30: A third strike sends more sparks, and the tinder begins to smolder.
reconstructed_captions.31: A small orange ember appears in the tinder and starts to glow.
reconstructed_captions.32: The man leans down close to the fire pit and gently blows on the ember.
